senses.gloss: रस- + अञ्जन रस- + अञ्जन, n. a particular sort of collyrium, Śiś. 9, 21.
रस- + आदान रस- + आदान, n. drying up.
रस- + आभास रस- + आभास, m. the semblance of sentiment, as e. g., a sentiment attributed to an irrational animal.
रस- + उपल रस- + उपल, n. A pearl.
राशि- + चक्र राशि- + चक्र, n. the zodiac.
रसा- + तल रसा- + तल, n. 1. the lowest of the seven hells, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 2. 2. the lower regions, Bhartṛ. 2, 32.
रशना रशना, see रसन.

रसन रस् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Sounding, tinkling.
 2. Tasting, Bhāṣāp. 39; Bhag. 15, 9.
 II. f. (written also रशना, and perhaps akin to रश्मि, q. cf.).
 1. A [] woman's girdle, Vikr. d. 115.
 2. The tongue, Bhāṣāp. 100.
 --Comp.
रासन रासन, m. = रस, Pāṇ. Sch. iv. 2, 92.

रश्मि रश्मि (i. e. रश् + मि; with रश् cf. probably Lat. laqueus, cf. रसना), m.
 1. A rein, Nal. 19, 22.
 2. A ray of light, Pañc. 162, 11.
 3. An eyelash.
 --Comp.

1. रस् रस्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To sound, Gīt. 10, 6.
 2. To roar, MBh. 3, 14602.
 3. To sing, Śiś. 6, 70.
 4. † To praise.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रसित, Sounded. n.
 1. The rattling of thunder, Ghaṭ. 14.
 2. Sound.
 --Cf. s. v.
 --Frequent. रारस्, To cry loudly, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 96.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, अनु-रसित, Accompanied by howling, Utt. Rāmac. 45, 2.
 --With आ आ, To lament, Nal. 1, 11. आरसित, n. Cry, Mālav. d. 41.
 --With वि वि, To cry, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 42.
 --Cf. Goth. razda; O.H.G. rartjan; A.S. reordian; O.H.G. rerjan; A.S. rarian.

2. रस् रस्, i. 10, रसय and रसू-पय [] (rather a denomin. derived from रस), Par.
 1. To taste, Śiś. 10, 27.
 2. † To love. Desider. रिरसयिष, To wish to taste, Śiś. 11, 11.
राश् राश्, v. r. for रास्.

रास् रास् (cf. रस्), i. 1, Ātm. (MBh. 8, 1941, Par.), To sound, to cry.
 --Cf. राश्.

रस रस, probably from रम्,
 I. m.
 1. Taste (as sweet, salt), Pañc. 61, 11.
 2. Pleasure, Utt. Rāmac. 146, 1; enjoyment, Śāk. d. 179; Pañc. ii. d. 175; charm, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
 3. Inclination, Hit. iii. d. 115 (साहस-एकान्त-रस-अनु-वर्तिन्, adj. One who follows only his inclination to inconsiderate haste); love, Utt. Rāmac. 26, 2.
 4. Juice, Man. 2, 77; liquid, 3, 159; Śiś. 9, 46; a dish, Vikr. 19, 1.
 5. Essence, Hit. iv. d. 94 (तद्-, Its best).
 6. Condiment, Hit. iii. d. 56.
 7. Water.
 8. The essential juice of the body, whence blood, etc., are supposed to be engendered.
 9. Semen virile.
 10. Poison.
 11. Gum myrrh.
 12. Quicksilver.
 13. A mineral substance, as sulphur, borax.
 14. Taste, sentiment, emotion, as an object of poetry, as love, terror, etc., Bhartṛ. 2, 21; Rām. 1, 4, 7; Pañc. v. d. 44 (? nine रसस् of music).
 15. Affection of the mind, Utt. Rāmac. 50, 8; passion, Vikr. d. 36; love, Vikr. d. 40.
 II. f. सा.
 1. A river of the lower regions, Chr. 297, 12 = Rigv. i. 112, 12.
 2. The tongue.
 3. The earth.
 4. A grape.
 5. The name of several plants.
 --Comp.

रास रास, i. e. रस् + अ, m.
 1. Sound.
 2. Confused noise.
 3. Speech.
 4. A festival among the cowherds, including especially a circular dance.
 5. A chain.
 --Comp.
रसक रस + क, m. Stewed or boiled meat.

रसज रस-ज, m.
 1. Any insect engendered by the fermentation of liquids.
 3. Molasses.

रसज्ञ रस-ज्ञ,
 I. adj. Acquainted with tastes, sentiments, etc.
 II. m.
 1. An alchymist.
 2. A physician.
 3. A poet.
 III. f. ज्ञा, The tongue, Bhāṣāp. 52; 101.
रसमय रस + मय, adj., f. यी, Delightful, Utt. Rāmac. 128, 1.

रसवन्त् रस + वन्त्, adj., f. वती,
 1. Succulent, Bhartṛ. 3, 97.
 2. Agreeable, Vikr. d. 62.
 3. Endowed with the रसस्, love, etc., Utt. Rāmac. 111, 3.

रसायन रसायन, perhaps रस-अयन,
 I. n.
 1. Buttermilk.
 2. Poison.
 3. A medicine preventing old age and prolonging life, Pañc. ii. d. 80; elixir, Hit. i. d. 209, M.M. (प्रीति-, Elixir-like joy).
 4. Medicine, a remedy, Utt. Rāmac. 24, 2.
 5. Alchymy, chemistry.
 II. m.
 1. An alchymist.
 2. Garuḍa.
 III. f. नी, A vessel conveying nutrition.

रसिक रसिक, i. e. रस + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Having taste, flavoured.
 2. Tasteful, as a composition.
 3. Impassioned, inclined, Hit. 103, 3 (साहस-एक-, Inclined only to inconsiderate haste).
 II. m.
 1. A horse.
 2. An elephant.
 3. A libertine.
 III. f. का (cf. रसन).
 1. A woman's girdle.
 2. The tongue.
 3. Curds with sugar and spice.
 4. Molasses.
रसिकता रसिक + ता, f. Pleasure, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 411.
रसित रसित, probably रस + इत, adj. Gilded, plated.
रस्न रस्न, n. A thing.
रास्ना रास्ना, f. A sort of perfume.

रस्य रस्य, i. e. रस + य,
 I. adj.
 1. Savoury, Bhag. 17, 8.
 2. Juicy.
 II. n. Blood.

राशि राशि, m.
 1. A heap, a quantity, Pañc. 121, 11; 203, 7.
 2. A sign of the zodiac.
 --Comp.

राष्ट्र राष्ट्र, m. and n.
 I. i. e. राज् + त्र,
 1. A realm, empire, kingdom, Pañc. iii. d. 39; v. d. 64 (कुराजान्तानि राष्ट्राणि, Kingdoms find their end [i. e. are ruined] by wicked kings).
 2. An inhabited country, Lass. 76, 18.
 II. Any public calamity, as famine.
 --Comp.
राष्ट्रिक राष्ट्रिक, i. e. राष्ट्र + इक, adj. sbst. Inhabiting, or an inhabitant of, a realm, Man. 10, 61.

राष्ट्रिय and राष्ट्रीय राष्ट्रीय,
 I. adj. Relating to a realm.
 II. (राष्त्र्ĭय), m. A king's brother-in-law (in theatrical language), Mṛcch. 66, 23; cf. Böhtl. ad Śāk. 73, 1.
रासभ रासभ, i. e. रस् + अ + भ, m. An ass, Pañc. iii. d. 118. f. भी, A she-ass, Pañc. 215, 9.

रासेरस रासेरस, m.
 I. i. e. रास + इ-रस.
 1. = रास.
 2. Mirth.
 3. A company, a party.
 II. (cf. रस), Alchymy.
रसना- + लिह् रसना- + लिह्, m. a dog.
रस- + विशेष रस- + विशेष, m. a more excellent juice, Pañc. ii. d. 37.
रस- + सिद्धि रस- + सिद्धि, f. knowledge of alchemy.

रस- + सिद्ध रस- + सिद्ध,
 I. adj. accomplished in poetry, Bhartṛ. 2, 21.
 II. m. an alchemist.
